paragraphs: QQQ is +0.45% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -30/100 (Cautiously Negative). Score path: pre-market -48 → now -30; open -29 → now -30 (deteriorated 1 points).

The main live drivers are The 2Y rate signal is a headwind: 4.692% (+5.7 bp vs prev close). Volatility are a headwind: VXN 28.28 (-1.53%) | VIX 19.51 (+2.52%). It changed from mixed to negative after the baseline snapshot. Rates are a headwind: the 10Y is 4.990%, -0.7 bp since the opening snapshot.
QQQ and its internal leadership are diverging, so the index move has weaker confirmation (semiconductors positive, mega-caps negative, breadth mixed).

What would change the view: improvement would require further easing in the 10Y toward/below 4.95%, broader participation, VXN/VIX cooling. Deterioration would be reinforced by a renewed 10Y break above roughly 5.05%, semiconductor leadership rolling over.
